page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan: left page is a fragment of a facing page with a narrow column of text at the left edge (partly cut off, not transcribed as main text); right page: one page of running text with running head "PARS II." and page number 89 at top right; no margin notes on the right page; the bottom of the page carries the signature line "F 5" and catchword "Eius".

main_text.p: alterius consequentem inter se multiplicando, factum per reliquum diuidendo: quotus enim datæ proportionis quartus erit.
Vt in datis 3. 2. 9. quæratur quartus, qui ad 9 itafe habeat, sicut 2 ad 3. Multiplica igitur 2 in 9, factumq; 18 diuide per 3 reliquum, quotus erit 6, quæsitus proportionali, sic: 3. 2. 9. 6.

Consequutionis ratio patet: quoniam habito exintermediis facto, perinde est, ac si factum a primo per quartum te habere profitearis, atq; id probaturus, siue quartum in facti inuolucris delitescentem, in apertum producturus, factum hunc primo diuidas, quotumq; ignotû alterum ex diuisi factoribus esse profitearis: quipe cum numerus omnis per quos factus est, per eos quoque diuidatur, factusq; omnis per alterum multiplicantium diuisus, reliquum prodat.

Vt in 9. 6. 12 quæratur quartus. Multiplicetur igitur 6 in 12, hoc est, intermedij inter se termini, factum 72 etiam factum esse ex multiplicatione 9 in quartum ignotum. Facto igitur habito, cum factorum unus cognitus sit, alter amplius non latebit. Quare 72 per 9 diuido, quotus erit 8 factorum alter, adeoq; quartus proportionalis, sic, 9, 6, 12, 8.
main_text.head: Regula hæc adhibetur proportioni vel Simplici, vel Multiplici.
main_text.p: Simplex est quæ terminis quatuor tantum constat.

page.notes: Left page is largely cut off and only partly legible; its visible fragments (e.g. "ex-", "Eu-", "caput", "Geo-") were not transcribed. Faint show-through from the reverse side appears across the right page and was omitted. Several words in the diagram-like mathematical lines are blurred (e.g. "quotumq; ignotum", "Multiplicetur", "72") and may be misread.
